Our story

A family-run team that treats every home like it's our own.

Olive & Oak began with a simple idea: buying a home should feel calm, not rushed. We're a small team of local agents who take the time to understand how you live, then show only the homes that fit.

We're honest about what a home needs, clear about every cost, and with you until the keys are in your hand.

FAQ

Helpful answers

Quick guidance on how to ask about a home, book a visit and use this website.

How can I ask about a property?

On any home, tap Enquire on WhatsApp. WhatsApp opens with a message already naming that home and its location, ready to send to 8840402243. The same button is inside View details. You can also call or email using the contact details in the footer.

How do I schedule a visit?

Open View details on a home and tap Schedule a visit, or use any Schedule a visit button on the page. Enter your name, email, preferred visit date and the property. Phone and message are optional. When your request is sent successfully, a confirmation appears on the page.

How do I search for homes?

Use the search bar below the top banner: type a city or neighbourhood, choose a property type and a price range, then press Search. To see every home again, clear the fields and search, or use Clear filters. The footer also has quick links for Apartments, Villas and Townhouses.

How do I save homes I like?

Tap the heart on a home's photo, or Save inside its details. The Saved homes button above the listings shows only the homes you saved. Your saved homes are remembered in this browser on this device only.

How do I compare two homes?

Tap Compare on two homes (the limit is two). A bar appears at the bottom of the screen. Press Compare now to see price, location, bedrooms, bathrooms and area side by side.

Can I see a home's photos and its area on a map?

Tap a home's photo to view it full screen. Each home currently has one photo. View area map opens the home's area and city in Google Maps in a new tab. It shows the area by name, not an exact address.

Are the amenities and neighbourhood descriptions final?

No. They are marked as sample information on the page. Please confirm details with us before relying on them.

How do I use the newsletter and the theme button?

To get updates, enter your email under Stay Connected in the footer and press Subscribe. A confirmation appears after a successful signup. The theme button in the header switches between light and dark, and your choice is remembered in this browser.
